findings.text: blocking: The first pass record is read before publishing a reload request or inspecting the pass lock, and an absent record returns True at :1611-1612; on first entry service_pass can acquire the lock and see no reload at :1327-1328, the supervisor can read the still-absent record and permit restart, then the service can publish its record and begin work before _restart_locked stops it, violating the pass-completion guarantee; serialize first-pass registration with the restart decision and add a controlled test for this ordering.
